current_role: U.S. Secretary of Defense, styled Secretary of War (since January 25, 2025)
summary: Pete Hegseth, a Princeton graduate and Army National Guard officer who served at Guantánamo Bay, in Iraq and in Afghanistan, led the advocacy groups Vets for Freedom and Concerned Veterans for America and became a Fox News host. Trump chose him as defense secretary; the Senate confirmed him 51–50 on January 24, 2025, with JD Vance breaking the tie. Under a September 2025 executive order he also uses the title Secretary of War, and in 2026 he designated Anthropic a supply-chain risk after it refused to drop limits on military uses of its AI.
